reviews.review_description: Solar Quotes were an enormous help to me during this process. I learnt about solar from their website and then obtained three quotes from the companies they recommended. Solar Quotes also answered any questions that I had regarding the brands.Two companies, All Brisbane Electrical and SAE Group Brisbane North Upper came to my house but not the third. I appreciated this face to face meeting. I was impressed with both companies and could easily have chosen either company. Both  were very patient with me, answering my many questions and being patient as I took some time making my decision. The whole process was simple. They were both prompt in returning my calls or answering my emails. I would recommend both companies.The installation went smoothly. They were punctual, tidy and easy to talk to. Everything was explained and after the safety meter was installed I was able to turn the system on. I turned the system on just over a week ago and I am very impressed with it. My system is producing more energy than I need which is what I wanted. The solar edge app is great.

We were after a quality solar system that will last us for a long time and that is exactly what Shaun from All Brisbane Electrical delivered. Shaun really listens for what you want to get out of your solar system and after a site inspection Shaun designed a system that straightaway appealed to us. We found the quote very reasonable for a premium solar system, and for the additional cost for the upgrade and repositioning of the electricity meter Shaun gave us a discount for he would be already on-site.Shaun and his team did a fantastic job installing the solar system and we are very pleased with the whole process. Every thing looks neat and tidy and his team were a pleasure to work with. We highly recommend All Brisbane Electrical if you are after quality workmanship.

After conducting alot of homework finding the right contractor and small business to install a solar system into our home, we chose Shaun and his staff from All Brisbane Electrical to complete the work after Shaun arrived to assess our home and discuss what we had in mind.We also got him to do some extra electrical work in our home and shed of which he gave us a great discount.His staff are very professional and conduct themselves in a high manner which gave me confidence that we had chosen the right Company which is very important to us.Our solar system is better than I imagined it, a very nice job indeed.I highly recommend Shaun and his team if honesty, knowledge, and professionalism is important to you.

I dealt with Shaun Murray from All Brisbane Electrical who provided me my 9.425kW solar system with REC panels and Solar Edge inverter with DC Optimisers.  I found him to be very helpful in providing information on the type of system i was after. He was able to supply and install the system to my time frames and commissioned the system without any issues.  His communication style was excellent and always kept me informed of progress. The price was very competitive.I would definitely recommend him and the company for your solar needs.

I cannot speak highly enough regarding Shaun and his team from All Brisbane Electrical.Being a builder who is ultimately responsible for the project I am very particular about the contractors which I use. All Brisbane Electrical is the only company I will use for Solar and Battery Storage due to their professionalism, quality of work, and knowledge regarding solar and battery storage. Shaun is always willing to meet and discuss my client's needs and budget, then design a system accordingly.

Shaun is a qualified electrician and the owner operator of All Brisbane Electrical. He handled the entire quoting process and actually climbed onto my roof to access the best position for the solar cells.  Everything went smoothly with the installation and occurred just the way said. Shaun was on the tools most of the time supervising his other two electricians who installed the system. The system is now up and running and working perfectly. I couldn't be happier about his installation of my solar system.  Shaun has a passion about solar power and I would recommend his company to anyone who wants a quality solar system installed correctly.

Shaun took all aspects of our electricity needs into account when installing our stand alone solar system. He gave a quote and he kept to that quote. He was very professional in everything he did. He and his team were very respectful and excellent to have working around us . The system he recommended and installed has worked way beyond our expectation. His follow up service has been really good and he has been very easy to contact. We highly recommend Shaun and his team.

1. Quoting process was straight forward, received 3 quotes for similar systems.2. Installation was carried out during the construction of my new house. Installers were polite and tidy.3. Customer service was excellent. System was fully connected and set up to the grid and wi-fi monitoring system.

Shaun was great to work with. He was very reliable and I felt really comfortable having him around the house why my young family was at home. He did what he said, when he said and kept me informed at all times. He gave me options that allowed me to select a system tat suited my needs. Install quality was great.
Shaun and his team installed my home solar system. He is very knowledgeable always contactable and polite. They completed a great installation with impeccable back up service.
Shaun knows solar inside out. He and his team did a great job that was on time and on budget. Good helpful after sales support.

Shaun was able to simplify the solar terminology so as we could understand what we required.High quality installation, good value for money and aftermarket support from All Brisbane Electrical has been exceptional

After waiting weeks for a response from other sparkys for a quote, I gave All Brisbane Electrical a call. Within 24 hrs we had our quote emailed and Shaun willingly spent some time chatting to my hubby about specifics. Quote approved and installed within the fortnight. Only took a day to have it up and running. All the crew were good natured and friendly - couldnâ€™t ask for better. If I could give 10 stars, heâ€™d get 20.

Shaun provided a very detailed and professional service specific to our household/family needs.  He took all aspects of our electricity needs into account when installing our system.  His customer service is second to none.  He is always on hand to offer his services, he is punctual and will go out of his way to look after his customers.  The system he recommended and installed is proving to be an outstanding investment and is by far, one of the best decisions we made with regards to the building of our new home.  Highly recommended.

Very happy with All Brisbane Electrical. Shaun is straight talking skilled tradesman who is very easy to deal with. His tradies were polite diligent and did excellent work. In spite of system being large ( relatively) it was all done in 1.5 days plus some other work as well.Site was kept clean and neat. Rubbish was disposed of and i had no other complaints.Additionally once contracted work was commenced within fortnight. Most other suppliers talked about 6 weeks at best.
On time for quote process, on time as scheduled for installation, good explanation of install process, good explanation of operation

Shaun did such a good job, I asked him to quote on aircon. Came back with a few options and we  setttled with ducting every room on the house and a Myzone3 controller. Amazing system and clean install.
Shaun and his team worked with us to deliver the system in our timeframe.  A neat installation that works well.

We recently had our 20kW system installed by Shaun from All Brisbane Electrical.We are very pleased with the skill expected of a professional and the care taken by the Shaun to do the job right until finished.Thank you Shaun.We have no hesitation and would recommend All Brisbane Electrical to our friends or anyone who needs a solar power system.We also would like to thank you Assurance Consulting completed the Solar Viability Study to show us the right sized system to suit our needs and worked with Shaun from All Brisbane Electrical to complete the installation.

I purchased a system my solar system in 2012 and it performed fairly well until January 2017 when the system developed a problem in not generation power when there was rain. The company that I  purchased the system off had closed their operation. I contacted All Brisbane Electrical who checked the system and found water in the connectors , replaced connectors and secured with stainless ties and clips as the original connectors were not secured off the roof. After this the system still did not function as it should, therefore, I had All Brisbane Electrical recheck the system and they found that the weather seals in the Trina panels had worn and allowed water in affecting the circuitry. Shaun from All Brisbane Electrical arranged the claim for replacement of the panels, which were still under warranty, installed the new panels and replaced the Inverter with the current model. The labour costs appeared to be fair for the time expended and the system is functioning very well.

We recently had an upgrade from a 2kw system to a 3kw system, installed by All Brisbane Electrical.These days it is very rare to strike such a attentive and caring team, we were most impressed with Shaun and his team for their professionalism, quality of products and workmanship.We have had no hesitation in recommending this company to prospective purchasers, as we have done.

Shaun Murray was a pleaure to deal with from getting quotes and answering all our questions to actually doing the installation.  Nothing was too much trouble.  He had good ideas on how to do the installation and made everything easy to understand. I would highly recommend Shaun and his company if you want a quality job with quality products at a reasonable cost  and great personal service.
